trustBoundaries: Meta webhook and media endpoints to adapters
API/worker to private VPS media volume
future worker/backup jobs to private object storage
active data plane to isolated backup/tombstone stores

threats.mitigation: deny-by-default backend capabilities, tenant/object scope and negative authorization tests
threats.test: cross-role and cross-record API requests return 403/404 without disclosure

threats.mitigation: Secure HttpOnly SameSite cookies, CSRF token, origin checks, rotation and privileged-session revocation
threats.test: forged cross-site state change is rejected and revoked session cannot act

threats.mitigation: raw-body signature verification, timestamp window, external-event uniqueness and idempotent inbox
threats.test: invalid signature, duplicate event and stale replay have no duplicate effect

threats.mitigation: allowlisted HTTPS hosts, DNS/IP validation on every redirect, private-range block, size and timeout limits
threats.test: loopback, metadata endpoint, DNS rebinding and redirect chain are blocked

threats.boundary: external attachment to private VPS quarantine and operational Dropbox handoff
threats.mitigation: quarantine, content MIME detection, size limits, hash, ClamAV freshness gate, authorized no-store reads and no Dropbox handoff before validation
threats.test: EICAR, polyglot, MIME mismatch and oversized files remain unavailable

threats.asset: authorized context, PII and commercial decisions
threats.boundary: CRM assistant adapter to AI operator
threats.mitigation: minimized context, no domain mutation tools, structured schema, code-enforced commercial rules, output filtering and <=30-day TTL
threats.test: injected message cannot reveal other records, secrets or mutate official state

threats.asset: source, CI credentials, images and production runtime
threats.mitigation: pinned lockfile/actions, SBOM, vulnerability scan, provenance, digest-only promotion and least-privilege CI
threats.test: tampered artifact or high-severity dependency blocks promotion

threats.asset: tokens, prompts, messages, PIX evidence and credentials
threats.mitigation: allowlisted structured fields, redaction, opaque internal IDs, secret scanning and 30-day operational retention
threats.test: synthetic canaries never appear in logs, errors or build artifacts

threats.asset: PII, irreversible deletion and commercial authority
threats.mitigation: orthogonal capabilities, MFA, no self-assignment, four-eyes deletion authorization/execution and append-only audit
threats.test: operator cannot self-elevate, approve and execute the same deletion, or access legal hold

threats.asset: messages, Fichas and external side effects
threats.mitigation: versioned effect matrix, stable idempotency keys, explicit outcome_unknown and human reconciliation without blind retry
threats.test: crash after remote acceptance cannot silently duplicate the effect

threats.asset: deleted subject data and privacy evidence
threats.mitigation: isolated immutable pseudonymous tombstone ledger reapplied before readiness and retained through last related backup
threats.test: old backup restore cannot reintroduce a deleted synthetic subject

threats.asset: database backups, durable commercial documents, Fichas and tombstones
threats.boundary: runtime/backup jobs to private object stores
threats.mitigation: separate buckets and credentials, encryption, private access, versioning/immutability, rotation and access audit
threats.test: public access and cross-bucket credentials fail; expired backup rotates at 35 days

threats.asset: availability of webhook, API, worker and storage
threats.mitigation: body/rate/concurrency limits, bounded queues, backpressure, timeouts, quotas, circuit breakers and alerting
threats.test: approved burst and oversized/slow requests degrade safely without data loss or retry storm

threats.asset: transient journey media and host capacity
threats.boundary: API/worker to private VPS media volume
threats.mitigation: private mount, least-privilege read/write modes, opaque paths, no public route, application authorization, quota and no backup
threats.test: edge and unrelated services cannot mount or list media; traversal, public access and reads without record authorization fail

threats.asset: expired journey media and privacy evidence
threats.boundary: PostgreSQL expiry jobs to private VPS media volume and Dropbox receipt
threats.mitigation: UTC expiry set to the earliest deadline, terminal-event job, daily safety sweep, idempotent delete and visible lost/delete-failed states; Dropbox pending never extends TTL
threats.test: controlled clock covers seven-day ceiling, earlier journey end, duplicate purge, missing bytes and failed operational handoff without retaining bytes
